map.Dropout 期望输出计算器，输入保留概率求 dropout 后的期望输出与推: Dropout expected-output calculator: enter the keep probability to compute the expected output after dropout and the inference-time scaling factor, helping understand neural-network regularization parameters.
map.保留概率 p = 1 − rate；训练期望 E[x] = p·x；缩放因子 =: Keep probability p = 1 - rate; training expectation E[x] = p*x; scaling factor = 1/p (inverted dropout)
map.训练时按 rate 随机置零并在保留分支乘 1/p，使期望与推理一致，推理阶段不: During training, randomly zero out by rate and multiply the kept branch by 1/p so expectation matches inference; at inference do no dropping and no scaling. This is implicit ensembling of many sparse subnetworks, suppressing neuron co-adaptation; rate commonly 0.1-0.5, too large causes underfitting.
map.训练期以概率 p 随机丢弃神经元，期望输出 E[out]=p·x，破坏 co-a: During training, randomly drop neurons with probability p, expected output E[out] = p*x, breaking co-adaptation for regularization.
map.推理期若不做缩放，需将权重乘 p(或训练期除以 p)使期望一致，即 invert: If inference does not scale, multiply weights by p (or divide by p at training) to match expectations, i.e., inverted dropout.
map.常用 p=0.5 于隐藏层、0.0~0.2 于输入层；过大 p 会欠拟合。: Commonly p=0.5 for hidden layers and 0.0-0.2 for input layers; too large p causes underfitting.
map.：输入 x=2.0, p=0.5：训练期期望输出=0.5×2=1.0。推理期若保: : input x=2.0, p=0.5: training expectation output = 0.5*2 = 1.0. If inference keeps all neurons, weights must be *0.5 so output expectation stays 1.0 (inverted dropout divides by p at training).
map.训练丢弃使激活期望变为 p·x，若不缩放推理输出会比训练期望大 1/p 倍，分布: Training dropout makes the activation expectation p*x; without scaling, inference output is 1/p times larger than the training expectation, causing distribution mismatch and performance drop; scaling restores consistent expectation.
map.在 Transformer 等大模型中常被 LayerNorm/BatchNor: In large models like Transformers it is partly replaced by LayerNorm/BatchNorm and weight decay, but remains effective regularization; modern usage combines dropout with attention dropout and stochastic depth.
